title: VK-only Encapsulated Interface Transport conservative MEI analogue
purpose: Create a distinct mutation-friendly encapsulated transport request with a compact MEI-style body so the receiver traverses less-common dispatch and payload handling code adjacent to prior crafted-message crashes.
expected_behavior: An implementation with Encapsulated Interface Transport support should either process the MEI selector path or reject it as unsupported while keeping framing synchronized and bounded.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0005 matches unit identifier plus 4-byte PDU
Target operation remains Encapsulated Interface Transport
issue_safety_notes: This request deliberately uses conservative framing and a short encapsulated payload as an analogue for crafted-message receive-path testing, not as a reproduction of any published crashing bytes.
